claims.claim_text: Commitment to condemn the mistreatment of imprisoned individuals wherever it occurs.
Disproportionate violence by policing and prisons accelerates institutional incentives to violate and imprison millions of people.
Commitment to lock up violent offenders.
Disproportionate violence by policing and prisons widens divisions between people.
Migrants, people of color and working class people are disproportionately criminalized in the United States.
Support for tough punishment of violent crime.
Support for addressing those who have been wrongly killed, hurt, and detained.
Punish brutality by U.S. federal agents.
Commitment to hold to account those who perpetrate human rights abuses.
Drug producing nations like Colombia have seen their societies torn apart by the intersection of criminal activity, political discord, and terrorism.
Demand for individuals in prisons, jails, detention centers, and camps to be let go.
